title: Hair Loss Pattern Triage
subtitle: First diagnostic branch: focal, patterned, diffuse, or scarring

steps.prompt: Is follicular ostia loss, scale, pustules, pain, or scarring present?

steps.detail: Biopsy the active edge rather than a fully scarred center; consider vertical and horizontal sections and DIF when lupus or immunobullous disease is possible.

steps.prompt: Is the loss round/patchy and sharply demarcated?
Is there scale, lymphadenopathy, black dots, or pediatric exposure risk?
Is thinning patterned at vertex, bitemporal scalp, or central part?

citations.quote: StatPearls Alopecia review summarizes pattern-based clinical assessment and biopsy considerations.
Goren A et al. Integrative and mechanistic approach to the hair growth cycle and hair loss. J Clin Med. 2023.
